summary: multi-acct resolves sole dependency to off-registry URL with install script
details: package.json and npm-shrinkwrap.json pin the sole dependency `vector-cursor-stream-engine` to `https://artifacts.yosiroute.com/npm/vector-cursor-stream-engine`, an off-registry host that is neither the npm registry nor a known publisher domain. The shrinkwrap entry sets `hasInstallScript: true`, so running `npm install multi-acct` fetches the tarball from that third-party URL and executes its lifecycle scripts on the installer's machine. The fetched artifact is unpinned (no integrity hash), mutable, and outside the registry's visibility, meaning whoever controls `artifacts.yosiroute.com` obtains arbitrary code execution on any machine installing this package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
